build_digest.na: ledger enumerates historical digests; no binary produced

corpus_digest.na: enumerates existing receipts; does not re-hash a corpus

exact_config.value: P0 fingerprint binding: path + LFS oid + size + producer head; payload verified against oid; fail closed when absent

raw_samples.na: supersession ledger, not a sample-bearing measurement

from.lfs_binding: hashed on-disk bytes (three-line pointer when unsmudged; full payload when smudged)

to.lfs_binding: logical path + LFS oid + payload size + producer head; payload resolved and sha256 verified against oid; absent object fails closed

scheme_change.why: v1 digests were not a function of payload identity under LFS: the same logical tree produced different source_sha256 values depending on smudge state, and an unsmudged tree bound only the pointer text. v2 binds the content-addressed OID and refuses when the payload cannot be verified.

policy.historical_receipts: never edited in place — editing a stored source_sha256 is forgery
policy.citation: a v1 source_sha256 must not be cited as current-tree identity under v2; re-run the producing proof under schema 2 to mint a successor
policy.worktreeContentDigest: NOT changed. control/dev_checkpoint.go hashes on-disk bytes for same-session before/after mutation restore. It has the same on-disk LFS ambiguity (pointer vs payload) but is session-local, never published as source_sha256, and is not a citable identity. No supersession applies.
